content.text: Nɑ kon de bu Sɑmɑri sɛɛyɑsiɑ
yèn sɔ̃ yen tɔmbu bɑ nɛ Gusunɔ ben Yinni seesi.
Bɑ koo bu ɡowɑ tɑbu sɔɔ
kpɑ bu ben bii piiminu nɑm.
Kpɑ bu ben kurɔ be bɑ ɡuri mɔn nukunu bɛsuku.
Osee u Isirelibɑ sɔ̃ɔwɑ u nɛɛ,
bu wurɑmɑ Gusunɔ ben Yinnin mi,
domi bɑ wɔrumɑ ben torɑnun sɔ̃.
Bu wurɑmɑ win mi bu kɑnɑ teni ko
te tɑ nɛɛ, Yinni Gusunɔ,
ɑ sun bɛsɛn torɑnu kpuro suuru kuo.
Kpɑ ɑ sun mɛɛri kɑ nɔnu ɡeu.
Ye sɑ ko kɑ nun yɑ̃kuru kuɑ,
sɑ ko nun siɑrɑ.
Asiriɡii wi, u ǹ kpɛ̃ u sun fɑɑbɑ ko.
Sɑ mɑɑ yɛ̃ mɑ dumi kun sun fɑɑbɑ mɔ̀ tɑbu sɔɔ.
Sɑ ǹ mɑɑ bwɑ̃ɑroku ni sɑ tii kuɑ sokumɔ bɛsɛn yinnibu pɑi.
Domi wunɑ ɑ rɑ ɡobekubɑ wɔnwɔndu kue.
Yinni Gusunɔ u nɛɛ,
kon de nɛn tɔmbu bu kɑ den nɛ turo yɔ̃rɑ
kpɑ n bu kĩɑ too.
Nɑ ǹ mɑɑ kɑ bu mɔru mɔ̀.
Ko nɑ n sɑ̃ɑwɑ nɡe kɑkoru be, Isirelibɑn sɔ̃.
Bɑ ko n wɑ̃wɑ nɡe dɑ̃ɑ wɛ̃su,
kpɑ bu nuuru ɡirɑ nɡe dɑ̃ɑ ni nu wɑ̃ɑ Libɑniɔ.
Ben kɑ̃ɑsi yi koo tɛriɑwɑ
kpɑ yi n wɑ̃ nɡe dɑ̃ɑ te bɑ mɔ̀ olifi,
kpɑ yi n nuburu do nɡe dɑ̃ɑ ni nu wɑ̃ɑ Libɑniɔ.
Bɑ koo ɡɔsirɑmɑ bu sinɑ nɛn kɔkɔrɔ
kpɑ bu mɑɑ ɑlikɑmɑ duure.
Bɑ koo kpɑrɑwɑ nɡe resɛm dɑ̃ɑ
kpɑ bu yĩsiru yɑri nɡe Libɑnin tɑm.
Sɑɑ ye, Isirelibɑ bɑ ǹ mɑɑ bũnu sɑ̃ɑmɔ.
Domi kon ben kɑnɑru nɔ,
kpɑ n bu nɔni doke.
Nɑ kon sɑ̃ɑwɑ nɡe dɑ̃ɑ ye yɑ ku rɑ ɡbere ben sɔ̃.
Nɛn min diyɑ bɑ koo domɑru wɑ.
Wi u lɑɑkɑri mɔ, u de u n tii sɛ ɡɑri yinin sɔ̃.
Wi u mɑɑ bwisi mɔ, u de yi nùn yeeri.
Domi Yinni Gusunɔn swɛɛ yi sɑ̃ɑwɑ dee dee.
Gemɡibɑ bɑ koo sĩ yi sɔɔ.
Adɑmɑ be bɑ nùn seesimɔ, bɑ koo wɔrumɑ yi sɔɔ.
